verdict_reason: A verbatim copy of the v3 suite, carrying a copied coverage-history comment.

todos.issue: PimsTransportMapperV4Test is PimsTransportMapperV3Test copied with three lines changed (the class name and the two mapper types). Nothing in it is specific to v0.4.0, so every transport-mapping test now has two homes.
todos.fix: Must: transport mapping that is the same in v0.3.0 and v0.4.0 is tested once, with per-version tests only for what differs. One way: share the transport mapper between versions and keep one suite, or parameterise one suite over both mappers.

todos.issue: Lines 37-39 narrate history about the class: 'Every other fixture in this class passes null for usedLogisticsTransportMeans, so the non-null branch of mapTransportMeans was never exercised — the vessel name could have been dropped or mis-wired without failing a test.' This is coverage history copied from the v3 test, and it describes the other tests rather than the lines below it.
todos.fix: Must: no history and no comment about other tests. One way: delete the comment. The title mapTransportMovement_shouldMapUsedLogisticsTransportMeans already says what the test proves.
